uptake.definition: n. a process of taking up or using up or consuming
uptake.translation:
n. 举起, 拿起, 理解, 上风井, 摄入, 吸收
[化] 摄取

uptakes.definition:
plural of uptake
n. a process of taking up or using up or consuming
uptakes.translation:
(uptake 的复数) n. 举起, 拿起, 理解, 上风井, 摄入, 吸收
[化] 摄取

uptalk.translation:
vi. 用升调说话
n. 升调发言 [亦作 up-talk]

upthrow.definition: n (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)
upthrow.translation: n. 向上的投掷, 隆起

upthrust.definition: n (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)
upthrust.translation: n. 上冲, 上冲断层

upthrusting.definition:
-ing form of upthrust
n (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)
upthrusting.translation: (upthrust 的现在分词) n. 上冲, 上冲断层

upthrusts.definition:
plural of upthrust
n (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)
upthrusts.translation: (upthrust 的复数) n. 上冲, 上冲断层

uptick.definition: n. a transaction in the stock market at a price above the price of the preceding transaction
uptick.translation: [商](股票)报升(成交价格比上一个交易高的成交或价格)

uptie.translation:
uptie (third-person singular simple present upties, present participle uptying, simple past and past participle uptied)
To tie up, fasten up.

uptight.definition: s being in a tense state
uptight.translation: a. 紧张的, 拮据的, 心情焦躁的

uptilt.translation: vt. 使向上翘起, 使向上倾斜

uptime.definition: n. a period of time when something (as a machine or factory) is functioning and available for use
uptime.translation: [计] 可用时间, 正常运行时间

upto.translation:
na. 到；干(着)；适于；…的责任
[网络] 高达；一直到；轮到

uptodate.translation: a. 直到现代的, 现时的, 最新式的

upton sinclair.translation: 厄普顿·辛克莱（美国作家）

uptown.definition:
n. a residential part of town away from the central commercial district
a. of or located in the upper part of a town
r. toward or in the upper part of town
uptown.translation:
n. 非中心区, 住宅区
a. 住宅区的

uptowner.definition:
comparative of uptown
n. a residential part of town away from the central commercial district
a. of or located in the upper part of a town
r. toward or in the upper part of town
uptowner.translation:
(uptown 的比较级) n. 非中心区, 住宅区
a. 住宅区的

uptrace.definition: v. t. To trace up or out.

uptrain.definition: v. t. To train up; to educate.

uptrend.translation: n. 上升趋势, 好转趋势

upturn.definition: n. an upward movement or trend as in business activity
upturn.translation:
n. 情况好转, 向上趋势
v. (使)向上, 转朝上, 翻转

upturned.definition:
s having been turned so that the bottom is no longer the bottom
s (used of noses) turned up at the end
upturned.translation: a. 朝上的, 翻过来的, 翻转的

upturning.definition:
-ing form of upturn
n. an upward movement or trend as in business activity
upturning.translation:
(upturn 的现在分词) n. 情况好转, 向上趋势
v. (使)向上, 转朝上, 翻转

upturns.definition: n. an upward movement or trend as in business activity
upturns.translation: n. 好转, 上升趋势( upturn的复数形式 )
